# BottleSumo 2026 — local board profile for the ESP32 Arduino core.
#
# Do not edit this file in place. scripts/install-arduino-board.sh merges the
# block below into <Arduino15>/packages/esp32/hardware/esp32/<version>/boards.local.txt
# and can remove it again. Every setting the stock "ESP32S3 Dev Module" exposes
# as a Tools menu is pinned here, so Tools > Board > "BottleSumo 2026 (ESP32-S3
# N16R8)" has nothing left to choose and no build can be misconfigured.
#
# Partition table: the core's default_16MB.csv, which is byte-identical to
# firmware/bottlesumo_arduino/partitions.csv and to the PlatformIO board
# descriptor boards/esp32-s3-devkitc1-n16r8.json:
#   nvs      0x9000   20 KiB
#   otadata  0xe000    8 KiB   (boot slot selection)
#   app0     0x10000   6.25 MiB (OTA slot A)
#   app1     0x650000  6.25 MiB (OTA slot B)
#   spiffs   0xc90000  3.43 MiB
#   coredump 0xFF0000  64 KiB
# upload.maximum_size is the app slot size, so the IDE rejects an image that
# cannot be swapped in.

# >>> bottlesumo-n16r8 >>>

bottlesumo_n16r8.name=BottleSumo 2026 (ESP32-S3 N16R8)

# Flash and image format: 16 MB quad flash at 80 MHz, QIO boot.
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.flash_size=16MB
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.flash_freq=80m
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.flash_mode=dio
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.boot=qio
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.boot_freq=80m

# 8 MB octal PSRAM (WROOM-1-N16R8, not the octal-flash N16R8V part).
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.psram_type=opi
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.memory_type={build.boot}_{build.psram_type}
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.defines=-DBOARD_HAS_PSRAM

# Two OTA slots; the first flash must still go over USB.
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.partitions=default_16MB
bottlesumo_n16r8.upload.maximum_size=6553600

# Native USB Serial/JTAG console on GPIO19/20 with CDC enabled at boot, and
# UART0 upload so both the CDC port and a USB-UART bridge can flash.
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.usb_mode=1
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.cdc_on_boot=1
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.msc_on_boot=0
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.dfu_on_boot=0
bottlesumo_n16r8.upload.use_1200bps_touch=false
bottlesumo_n16r8.upload.wait_for_upload_port=false
bottlesumo_n16r8.upload.speed=921600

# Core plumbing inherited from the stock esp32s3 entry.
bottlesumo_n16r8.bootloader.tool=esptool_py
bottlesumo_n16r8.bootloader.tool.default=esptool_py
bottlesumo_n16r8.upload.tool=esptool_py
bottlesumo_n16r8.upload.tool.default=esptool_py
bottlesumo_n16r8.upload.tool.network=esp_ota
bottlesumo_n16r8.upload.maximum_data_size=327680
bottlesumo_n16r8.upload.flags=
bottlesumo_n16r8.upload.extra_flags=
# The core's flasher command substitutes this verbatim; without the key the
# literal "{upload.erase_cmd}" reaches esptool and the upload aborts.
bottlesumo_n16r8.upload.erase_cmd=
bottlesumo_n16r8.serial.disableDTR=false
bottlesumo_n16r8.serial.disableRTS=false
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.tarch=xtensa
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.bootloader_addr=0x0
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.target=esp32s3
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.mcu=esp32s3
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.core=esp32
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.variant=esp32s3
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.board=ESP32S3_DEV
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.f_cpu=240000000L
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.loop_core=-DARDUINO_RUNNING_CORE=1
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.event_core=-DARDUINO_EVENT_RUNNING_CORE=1
bottlesumo_n16r8.build.copy_jtag_files=0

# <<< bottlesumo-n16r8 <<<
